name: Divide and choose
summary: Two-player fair division procedure where one player splits a resource and the other picks a share.
rules_text: There are two players: Cutter and Chooser. The resource to divide is divisible and players have private, possibly different valuations. Cutter divides the resource into two pieces (by his own valuation ideally equal). Chooser then inspects the two pieces and selects one to keep for himself based on his own valuation. Cutter receives the remaining piece. Each player aims to maximize the subjective value of the piece they receive. The procedure guarantees envy-freeness: each can secure at least what they perceive as half.
rating_reason: Classic turn-based fair division, strategic preference manipulation
